newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Belle to raise stake in gaming ventures.
newsitem.headline: Belle to raise stake in gaming ventures.

text.p: The Philippines' Belle Corp said on Monday it planned to put up 50 to 60 betting outlets in the first quarter of next year once Congress approves its jai-alai franchise application.
Belle chairman Jaime Gonzalez told reporters after the company's stockholders meeting that the company was eyeing 1.8 billion pesos in capital expenditure next year.
The House of Representatives earlier approved a bill granting a Belle subsidiary the right to build, operate and maintain jai alai betting outlets all over the country.
Jai alai is a popular Basque wicket and ball game.
Of Belle's 1998 capex, half will be used for a golf and resort project in Tagaytay, north of Manila and the rest for additional leisure projects of the company, Gonzalez said.
Gonzalez said he expected profits this year to exceed 1996 figures but he did not give any details. Belle reported a 535.8 million pesos net income last year.
